definitions: A unit of time, typically an hour, that an employee has accrued as paid time off.
A segment of an employee's allocated paid time off, often used for personal appointments, vacation, or sick leave.
examples: I have 40 PTO hours saved up.
She used a PTO hour for her dentist appointment.
How many PTO hours do you have left this year?
Employees can accrue PTO hours based on their length of service.
